Game Overview

In Endless Car Chase, the core idea is straightforward: dive into the exhilarating chaos of Endless Car Chase, where evading the relentless police becomes a thrilling art. Customize your ride, collect power-ups, and master sharp maneuvers as you navigate through hectic streets. With every heart-pounding chase, design your unique escape experience while pursuing the ultimate high score.
